cross_package_notes.note: Verified read-only cross-package contract of types.IsGeneratedQuestionSource(chunkID, sourceID, sourceType) and RetrieveParams.ExcludeGeneratedQuestionKBIDs: both Weaviate and TencentVectorDB retrieval paths now filter generated-question rows for KBs listed in ExcludeGeneratedQuestionKBIDs while preserving primary chunk body rows and FAQ/enabled-question KB hits.

invariants_checked: Every Cypher query across AddGraph, DelGraph, SearchNode, and SearchGraph parameterizes all entity names, attributes, chunk IDs, search terms, and namespace/knowledge_base_id values ($nodes, $relationships, $cypherIterateQuery, $cypherParams, $term, $terms, $maxSeedNodes, $maxNeighborsPerNode, $maxEdges), while all dynamic backticked identifiers (Label and sanitizeCypherIdentifier) strip null bytes and double backticks (` -> ``).

DelGraph passes inner APOC iterate Cypher and inner parameter maps strictly via outer Cypher parameters ($cypherIterateQuery, $cypherParams), uses DETACH DELETE with parallel: false to avoid Neo4j relationship-lock/still-has-relationships failures, consumes APOC result records to reject nonzero failedBatches, and preserves whole-KB deletion when namespace.Knowledge is empty while scoping single-document deletion with {kg: $kg}.

Graph writes, deletions, entity searches, and 1-hop neighbor expansions never cross namespace/knowledge_base_id boundaries: empty KnowledgeBase (and empty Knowledge on AddGraph) fails closed before opening any Neo4j session, and blank search terms return empty GraphData without running unbounded CONTAINS "" full-KB scans.

Neo4j sessions enforce bounded transaction timeouts (WithTxTimeout), preserve retryable error chains via %w wrapping so neo4j.IsRetryable works inside ExecuteWrite/ExecuteRead, bound seed nodes (maxSeedNodes = 25), per-seed neighbors (maxNeighborsPerNode = 30), and total edges (maxTotalEdges = 150), and contain zero legacy brand or host-path residues.

findings.summary: DelGraph concatenated backtick-escaped label expressions directly inside double-quoted outer Cypher string literals in CALL apoc.periodic.iterate("MATCH (n:" + labelExpr + " ...) ...", ...), allowing double-quote/backslash characters in namespace identifiers to break out into arbitrary outer Cypher; it also omitted DETACH DELETE, set parallel: true on relationship/node deletion, discarded APOC failedBatches without consuming the result, broke whole-KB deletion when Knowledge was empty by matching {kg: ""}, and wrapped errors with %v (breaking neo4j.IsRetryable).

AddGraph, DelGraph, and SearchNode did not fail closed on empty namespace.KnowledgeBase (or empty namespace.Knowledge in AddGraph), AddGraph lacked nil/blank node/relation guards and null-byte/backtick sanitization on LLM-extracted relationship types, and SearchNode/SearchGraph allowed blank/whitespace search terms to execute CONTAINS "" matching every node in the KB while SearchNode omitted WithTxTimeout and %w error wrapping.

invariants_checked: Weaviate class names are sanitized and validated against ^[A-Z][_0-9A-Za-z]*$ before GraphQL interpolation, and matchesCollection requires an exact <base>_<positive_dim> suffix so sibling collection prefixes and malformed schema class names are never queried or mutated.

VectorRetrieve, KeywordsRetrieve, and getBaseFilter fail closed when both KnowledgeBaseIDs and KnowledgeIDs are empty/blank (or when provided KnowledgeBaseIDs, KnowledgeIDs, or TagIDs slices contain only whitespace), preventing cross-KB/cross-tenant data leakage; DeleteBy*, CopyIndices, and MoveKnowledgeIndices validate non-empty targets and positive dimensions.

Multi-value ExcludeKnowledgeIDs and ExcludeChunkIDs emit one scalar filters.NotEqual operand per ID rather than invalid NotEqual array valueText, ExcludeGeneratedQuestionKBIDs filters generated-question vectors across both vector and BM25 retrieval, and GraphQL responses check both transport errors and GraphQL errors arrays without unchecked type assertions.

Save, BatchSave, and CopyIndices derive deterministic RFC 4122 UUIDs per SourceID (preserving primary chunk UUIDs while preventing generated-question rows from overwriting primary chunk vectors) and surface per-object batch errors; BatchUpdateChunkEnabledStatus and BatchUpdateChunkTagID resolve object UUIDs by chunk_id and apply non-destructive PATCH merges (WithMerge) across all matching dimension collections; default collection prefix is Genyee_embeddings with zero legacy residues.

findings.summary: VectorRetrieve, KeywordsRetrieve, and getBaseFilter did not fail closed when KnowledgeBaseIDs and KnowledgeIDs were empty or blank (querying all tenants' enabled chunks globally), getBaseFilter emitted invalid multi-value array NotEqual GraphQL filters when ExcludeKnowledgeIDs or ExcludeChunkIDs had multiple entries, collection name resolution/matching lacked ^[A-Z][_0-9A-Za-z]*$ validation and positive-dimension suffix isolation, Retrieve ignored ExcludeGeneratedQuestionKBIDs, and DeleteBy*/CopyIndices/MoveKnowledgeIndices lacked empty-target and invalid-dimension guards.

BatchUpdateChunkEnabledStatus and BatchUpdateChunkTagID reused outer err across loop iterations (aborting all subsequent chunk/collection updates after the first miss/error), omitted WithMerge() (sending destructive PUT replacements that wiped all other object properties instead of PATCH merges), and passed chunkID directly as object UUID (missing generated-question and copied vectors); Save and BatchSave keyed object IDs solely on ChunkID (causing generated-question vectors to overwrite chunk body vectors and rejecting non-UUID chunk IDs) while BatchSave/CopyIndices ignored per-object batch response errors.

parseGraphQLResponse, VectorRetrieve, KeywordsRetrieve, CopyIndices, and copySourceReader.query performed unchecked nil/type assertions on GraphQL payloads (panicking on malformed responses), parseGraphQLResponse failed to parse Weaviate string-encoded BM25 _additional.score values (leaving keyword scores at 0.0 or 1.0), KeywordsRetrieve truncated cross-collection results without sorting by descending BM25 score, and fromWeaviateVectorEmbedding omitted VectorScore and IsEnabled.

invariants_checked: All TencentVectorDB filter expressions (baseFilter, DeleteBy*, updateChunkFields, BatchUpdateChunkContent, copySourceQueryParams, and MoveKnowledgeIndices) escape backslashes, double quotes, and control newlines while stripping null bytes via filterIn/filterNotIn instead of unescaped SDK tcvectordb.In/NotIn string formatting.

VectorRetrieve, KeywordsRetrieve, and baseFilter fail closed when both KnowledgeBaseIDs and KnowledgeIDs are empty/blank (or when provided filter slices contain only whitespace), and DeleteBy*, CopyIndices, copySourceQueryParams, and MoveKnowledgeIndices guard against empty KB/document/chunk targets, invalid dimensions, and nil clients.

All SDK errors returned or logged across repository operations pass through redactTencentErr so Authorization Bearer headers and api_key secrets are scrubbed to [REDACTED] while preserving numeric error codes (e.g., code: 15202).

matchesCollection enforces exact <base>_<positive_dim> suffix matching when useDimensionSuffix is active, ExcludeGeneratedQuestionKBIDs is enforced on both vector and BM25 retrieval results, VectorScore is populated on embedding matches, offline Jieba stopwords pre-seeding uses GENYEE defaults (genyee / genyee_embeddings), and zero legacy brand or host-path residues exist.

findings.summary: All filter builders called upstream tcvectordb.In/NotIn (which interpolates unescaped fmt.Sprintf("\"%v\"", v)), allowing quotes/backslashes in KB, document, chunk, or tag IDs to break out into arbitrary filter predicates; VectorRetrieve, KeywordsRetrieve, and baseFilter failed open across all KBs when KnowledgeBaseIDs and KnowledgeIDs were empty/blank; copySourceQueryParams omitted knowledge_base_id scoping when sourceKnowledgeBaseID was empty; and DeleteBy*/CopyIndices/MoveKnowledgeIndices lacked blank-target, dimension, and nil-client guards.

SDK error returns and warnings exposed raw Authorization Bearer account/api_key credentials without redaction, matchesCollection used strings.HasPrefix(collectionName, base+"_") without validating a positive numeric dimension suffix (matching sibling store collections sharing a prefix), VectorRetrieve and KeywordsRetrieve ignored ExcludeGeneratedQuestionKBIDs, and toIndexWithScore left VectorScore unset on embedding matches.
